jobs.title: Glean: Designated Technical Support Engineer - West
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  Remote - US
 

    About Glean:   
   
  Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.  
   
  At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.  
   
  Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.  
   
  If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.      
   About the Role:   
   
  Glean is looking for a talented Designated Technical Support Engineer to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup.  We are building a modern knowledge assistant personalized to every employee in your organization, making all information within your company accessible, contextual, and fresh. Our team works hard and plays hard. We are professional, creative, passionate, and most importantly - customer-obsessed.  
   
  As a trusted technical resource to the customer, you will provide both proactive and reactive support to our growing customer base. By providing the highest level of service to our customers, you will ensure our customer experience is the best in the industry.  
   
   You will:   
 
 
  Own the proactive and reactive support for Glean customers by prioritizing issues for your designated customer(s)  
  Meet with your assigned customers regularly to review issues and develop resolution plans and drive continuous improvement in how you and your Glean teammates provide support to them  
  Be available to your assigned customers via collaborative communication channels consistently to ensure you are providing timely responses and updates on issues  
  Create and maintain customer-specific runbooks and knowledge articles  
  Provide first response, technical troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-through of customer issues and inquiries  
  Assist customers in the configuration, set-up, and verification of new content sources and product features to enable them to realize additional value for their users  
  Educate customers on the use of Glean product features  
  Identify system and user health issues, then create and execute remediation plans while coordinating and updating the customer accordingly  
  Handle customer-impacting alerts which require coordination with customer admin and system resources through resolution  
  Work closely with teams across Glean to drive product, process, and service improvements  
  Drive key improvement projects that will improve the scale and efficiency of support, while providing upgrades to the customers’ support experience  
  Coordinate all support activities with your assigned customer(s), which may include more stringent access and security processes, ensuring you move with high urgency for their issues.  
  Represent the unique needs of your assigned customer(s) with respect to product and security improvements that will improve the customer support experience

 Reddit is where people come to discover, research, and discuss products that inform their purchasing decisions. Shopping, across advertising and organic experiences, is a high priority for the company, and product catalogs are foundational to that work. 
 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Reddit’s Product Catalogs team. You will lead a full-stack engineering team responsible for the infrastructure and advertiser-facing experiences that help thousands of advertisers onboard, organize, and manage millions of products. Your team will build intuitive UIs, robust APIs, and scalable backend systems for catalog ingestion, storage, and product data management. 
 These systems power Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) and organic shopping, connecting users with relevant products in the context of their interests and conversations. Someone browsing r/golf might discover popular golf clubs, while someone reading a discussion about sunglasses in r/BuyItForLife might see the exact models being discussed. Your team will make it easier for advertisers to bring their products to Reddit and participate in these moments of discovery. 
 In this role, you will set technical direction, develop engineers, and drive execution across the catalog platform and advertiser experience. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to understand customer needs and make catalog onboarding and management seamless. You will also partner with Reddit’s Knowledge Graph teams to support organic shopping experiences. 
 This role calls for strong technical judgment, people leadership, and a focus on customer needs. It is based in Reddit’s Amsterdam or London office, with a team working across European time zones. 
  Responsibilities:  
 
 Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products 
 Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences 
 Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads 
 Establish and manage to SLAs within your team 
 Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team 
 Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride. 
 
  Required Qualifications:  
 
 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development 
 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams 
 You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them. 
 Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously. 
 Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences. 
 
  Benefits:  
 
 Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support 
 Family Planning Support

   About Mixpanel  
 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at  mixpanel.com .    About the Customer Digital Experience Team  
 Customer Digital Experience sits within the technical arm of Mixpanel's Customer Success organization. 
 Our sharpest focus is the digital-only segment: thousands of companies with no proactive account coverage. Some have technical resources available to them, but that support is entirely reactive. It answers the ticket and solves the problem in front of it. Nobody is watching for the customer who implemented and then never built a report, or the account whose usage has been sliding for a month. Our job is to be proactive,, and everything we build should be as automated as possible, without a human initiating it. 
 Our programs run across the full customer base and are not one-size-fits-all. We build flows that branch and adapt by segment, tuning the content, timing, and channel for who's receiving them. An onboarding flow for a digital-only customer carries the whole experience; the version reaching an account with a dedicated team is tuned to complement what that team is already doing. Same underlying program, deliberately different execution, continuously optimized based on what each segment responds to. 
 We're close to the data and to the technical reality of how customers implement and use Mixpanel. We're not guessing at what customers are doing; we can see it, and we build against it. This is a small, new team standing up a new function. The playbook isn't written yet; we're writing it together. 
  About the Role  
 As our Digital Adoption & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own the communications that drive adoption, retention, and expansion across Mixpanel's customer base, with our digital-only customers as the sharpest test of whether the programs work. You'll design lifecycle programs triggered by real behavior: a team that just implemented but hasn't built their first report, an account whose query volume dropped for three straight weeks, a power user hitting the edge of their current plan. Then you'll write the emails and in-product messages that move them forward. 
 This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's role. You'll define the segmentation, write the copy, set up the triggers, instrument the measurement, and then argue with the data about what to change. 
 It's also a deeply collaborative one. You'll work hand in hand with our Customer Success Digital Programs Manager, sharing a roadmap and dividing the work. You'll partner with Marketing on the overall email calendar so our lifecycle sends and their campaigns aren't competing for the same inbox. You'll support adoption initiatives coming out of Product, turning a launch into something customers actually try. And you'll take cues from customer-facing teams about what's landing and what isn't. Very little of this job happens alone. 
 You'll also help define what agentic customer success looks like at Mixpanel. The scaled programs we build today are rules and triggers; the ones we build next will involve AI agents that can interpret a customer's situation, decide what that customer needs, and act. We're early here and we don't have the answers. We want someone who is already experimenting, who already has opinions about where agents help and where they break trust, and who wants to shape how this gets built. 
 If you like clean handoffs and finished systems, this isn't it. If you want to build the thing from zero and own the number it moves, read on. 
  Responsibilities  
 
 Build the lifecycle communication program end-to-end across onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, from strategy through copy, build, launch, and iteration 
 Create programs that serve the full customer base while working hardest for digital-only customers, and decide where messaging should differ for accounts with a dedicated team 
 Design behavior-based segmentation using product usage, health signals, lifecycle stage, and account attributes; define the triggers that decide who hears from us and when 
 Write clear, useful customer-facing copy across email, in-product messaging, and other digital channels that reflects Mixpanel's voice and gives customers a reason to act 
 Build and ship campaigns in tools like Customer.io, HubSpot, and Statisfy, including the audience logic, templates, and QA that keep them reliable 
 Partner with Marketing on the shared email calendar, coordinating timing, frequency, and audience overlap so customers get a coherent experience instead of three messages in one week 
 Support product-led adoption initiatives by translating launches and feature pushes into lifecycle moments

About Syd Life AI   We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living .  Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries .  Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA .  Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity .   The role   Syd is looking for an AI Research Engineer to join the AI & Research team and work directly with the team lead on open problems across the full range of Syd's work , from the intelligence members interact with to the models , data and research systems behind it . AI tools write most of the code in our team , and you will use them every day . Your contribution is the question you ask , the experiment you design , the measurement you trust and the decision you can defend . Autonomy is high : you choose problems and propose ideas , with direction and review from the team lead .   What you bring   
  A PhD in a quantitative or life science field , such as neuroscience , mathematics , physics , biomedical engineering , statistics or computational biology , or an equivalent record of original research that is active and recent .  
  First-hand work with real , imperfect data , and confidence with study design , effect sizes , uncertainty , baselines and calibration .  
  A first-principles understanding of how large language models are trained and adapted ( pre-training , SFT , LoRA , distillation , PPO and GRPO ) , with hands-on practice in at least one .  
  Evidence discipline : you state what result would prove you wrong before you run the experiment , and report negative results as readily as positive ones .  
  Daily use of coding agents and frontier models , with a clear way of checking their output .  
  Clear , concise written English and comfort working autonomously in a remote team .  
   What you will do   
  Design new behaviours , memory and tools for language model agents that support members across every dimension of their life quality .  
  Design evaluations before a feature is built , with automated judges validated against human review .  
  Build methods that turn the scientific literature into structured , source-checked evidence .  
  Train predictive models on large real-world datasets , with attention to calibration , bias and validity across populations .  
  Fine-tune and evaluate open and closed models where a specialised model serves people well .  
   Terms   Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world . Consulting agreement with equity .   How to apply   Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/ai-research-engineer , with a research sample and a one-page note as described on the page .  Front end — build and improve TypeScript front-end features and fix UI bugs. 
 Data — write PostgreSQL queries and simple migrations (Spring Data JPA, Liquibase). 
 Integrations — help connect internal and external services via REST APIs and webhooks; keep OpenAPI specs up to date. 
 Async & workflow — monitor background jobs and scheduled processes (JobRunR) and help investigate failed jobs. 
 Platform features — contribute to document storage (S3), email and PDF generation, and SMS (Twilio) features.

 Nice to Have

 AWS basics (S3), Docker or CI/CD pipelines. 
 Twilio, PDF generation or email templating (Thymeleaf). 
 Interest in fintech, lending or regulated industries. 
 Spanish or Portuguese in addition to English. 
 A GitHub profile or portfolio showing projects you've built. 
 
 
  Working Arrangement  
 This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor sets their own schedule, methods and location, and provides their own equipment, workspace, reliable internet and a quiet setting suitable for phone calls with users. 
 The contractor should generally be reachable during a window overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is when users call for support and when planning, code reviews and team discussions happen; it is not a mandated schedule or minimum-hours requirement.

 This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, social contributions, insuran

 Design scalable APIs and data models that support new transaction types, products, and regulatory requirements without increasing operational burden.  
 Write well-tested, production-grade code that other critical systems depend on.

 5+ years of experience building backend systems in a production environment.

 Background in fintech or financial services.

 Comprehensive health plans 
 401K with company matching 
 Paid Parental Leave 
 Flexible time off

jobs.title: ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  Remote-US-CA
 

  ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.    We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical force multiplier across three pillars of our Platform Engineering organization: Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management. Together, these teams own the connectors, orchestration, and data quality capabilities that push ZoomInfo's data product into the systems our customers run every day. 
 This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role. You will embed with whichever team needs the most help at a given time. That might mean a major initiative, a stubborn area of tech debt, a reliability problem, or a chance to grow into new territory. You will lead through influence, not authority. You will set technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and work with Managers, engineers, and Product to turn ambiguity into well-architected, shipped solutions. 
 You will report directly to the Senior Director of Software Engineering and work closely with three Engineering Leaders and their teams. 
  The Three Pillars You'll Support  
 
  Integrations:  Native connectors and APIs that link ZoomInfo to CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, data warehouse, and BI platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Snowflake, and others), processing millions of records daily. 
  Workflows & Orchestration:  The engine behind lead-to-account matching and multi-step, event-driven business processes triggered by buying signals and business rules. 
  Data Management:  Deduplication, standardization, enrichment, continuous verification, and GDPR/CCPA compliance that keep customer data clean, current, and trustworthy. 
 
  What You'll do:  
 
 Embed with Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management teams on a rotating basis, writing production-quality code and unblocking the hardest technical problems 
 Define and evolve scalable, fault-tolerant, event-driven architecture on Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/NestJS, Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal or Google Cloud Workflows 
 Lead response and root-cause analysis for high-severity incidents and systemic reliability issues 
 Drive platform modernization by consolidating integration patterns, re-architecting legacy systems, and improving observability 
 Establish best practices for idempotency, retries, error handling, state management, API and webhook versioning, and workflow design 
 Shape multi-quarter roadmaps with the Senior Director, Engineering Managers, and Product, bringing technical feasibility, sizing, and risk into prioritization 
 Lead build-vs-buy evaluations and author architecture decision records and design docs that guide teams over multiple quarters 
 Mentor engineers at all levels and serve as a senior interviewer to raise the hiring bar 
 
  What you bring:  
  Must-Have  
 
 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in senior or staff-level roles, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams 
 Deep experience designing and operating backend distributed systems at scale, with strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and/or Node.js (NestJS) 
 Experience building or owning integrations or connectors with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, or data warehouse platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Snowflake, or similar) 
 Demonstrated ability to influence without authority by aligning teams, driving decisions, and earning trust across engineering, product, and business stakeholders 
 Strong track record leading platform modernization, reliability, and observability initiatives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executive leadership 
 
  Preferred  
 
 Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal, Google Cloud Workflows, or Airflow 
 Working knowledge of data quality practices: deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and GDPR/CCPA compliance 
 Experience with API strategy, webhooks, partner/ISV integration programs, and no-code/low-code workflow builders 
 Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP), build-vs-buy evaluations, vendor management, and SaaS cost optimization 
 
   
 #LI-LM1

Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.
